title: Tranquility on the Preserve
meta_description: Find the perfect WaterSound Beach, FL vacation rental at ‘Tranquility on the Preserve’ a luxury 6-bedroom, 6 full & 2 half bathroom vacation rental. Ideal for 18 guests, this home offers a Private Pool, Deeded Beach Access & Golf Cart for your enjoyment.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • Private Pool + Waterfall feature (Pool can be heated for an additional $70 per day from October 1 - May 1) • Carriage House & Game Room with tap • Summer Kitchen & Outdoor Dining • Gated Community with On-Site Security • Deeded Beach Access, Community Pool, Park & Pool Bar/Grill • Elevator • Multiple Balconies and Observation Tower with Gulf Views • Four-Seater Golf Cart & Six Adult Bikes Included SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: FIRST FLOOR: • Bedroom 1: Primary Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities, Soaking Tub & Walk-in Shower SECOND FLOOR: • Bedroom 2: Primary Bedroom with King Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Double Vanities, Soaking Tub & Walk-in Shower • Bedroom 3: Guest Bedroom with Queen Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity & Walk-in Shower • Bedroom 4: Guest Bedroom with Queen Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity & Shower/Tub Combination THIRD FLOOR: • Bedroom 5: Bunk Room with Two Queen Over King Bunk Beds (sleeps 8) & ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity & Shower/Tub Combination CARRIAGE HOUSE: • Bedroom 6: Guest Room with Queen Murphy Bed (sleeps 2) & ensuite Bathroom – Single Vanity & Shower/Tub Combination DESCRIPTION: Behind the Gates of WaterSound Beach is the luxurious retreat of ‘Tranquility On The Preserve’. With an expansive open floor plan perfect for hosting up to 18 guests, this vacation home creates an unforgettable atmosphere for family gatherings and celebrations. The kitchen is a dream come true for culinary enthusiasts, showcasing stainless-steel appliances, a spacious commercial refrigerator/freezer, a gas range, an oversized island, a pot filler, recessed lighting, and a wet bar with a full-size wine cooler. In the adjoining living room, plush furnishings invite relaxation while guests enjoy a large mounted flat-screen television. This level also features the first primary suite, which boasts a luxurious king bed, a cozy in-suite coffee nook, large transom windows, and a stunning private bathroom adorned with exquisite wall-to-wall and floor-to-ceiling marble tile, a glass-enclosed shower, dual vanities, and a generous soaking tub. Ascending to the second floor, you'll find four guest rooms that offer a variety of sleeping arrangements, including a secondary primary suite with soaring vaulted ceilings, a sumptuous king bed, a cozy sitting area with a sectional sofa and mounted TV, an additional coffee nook, and a spacious private bathroom. The third and fourth guest bedrooms each provide a queen bed and private bathroom, while the energetic bunk room delights with a large mounted television and two built-in queen-over-king bunk beds, plus its own private bathroom with a dual shower and contemporary trough sink. For a private escape, the carriage house enhances your stay with a queen-size murphy bed, a private bathroom with a shower, a sectional sofa, a projector television with Apple TV, and a kitchenette equipped with a full-size refrigerator/freezer, cooktop, microwave, and dishwasher, ensuring a sense of seclusion while remaining connected to the main house. Outside, ample seating surrounds the pool and kitchen area, featuring a soothing waterfall and rain wall that create a tranquil ambiance. The outdoor dining area overlooks the pool, complemented by an overhead fan for comfort on warm days. The summer kitchen entices culinary talents with a grilling station and pizza oven. Venture to the second-floor balcony, where numerous lounge chairs beckon you to soak in breathtaking views and follow the spiral staircase to discover the third-floor lounge area nestled among a canopy of treetops and reach beautiful heights from the observation tower which encompasses Gulf and Coastal Dune Lake views. Take a leisurely stroll along the winding boardwalks, where the sugar-white sand beach and shimmering emerald waters await, making ‘Tranquility on The Preserve’ a true haven that promises to elevate your stay in the most luxurious way. RESTAURANTS NEARBY: • The Dunesider Grill (Pool Bar Across the Street) • Bruno's (Casual Pizza in Gatehouse) • The Big Chill (Variety of Restaurants/Super Family Friendly) • Pizza By The Sea (Casual) • La Co Latin Coastal (Casual) • Reel ‘Em In (Seafood Market) • Amavida (Coffee) • The Citizen (Fine Dining) • Old Florida Fish House (Casual) • Cowgirl Kitchen (Casual) • La Crema (Tapas) • Pescado (Fine Dining/No Kids) • Paradise (Fine Dining) • Summer Kitchen (Casual) • Charlie’s Cafe (Coffee & Donuts) • Edwards (Fine Dining) • Seacrest Sundries (Grocery/Grab & Go)
